result.summary: Several layout and visual polish issues: truncated restaurant names and category chips, a loading spinner over a featured card, and a notification badge sitting outside the bell icon.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' is cut off at the right edge, so the name 'Trattoria Piccol...' and part of the image are truncated.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal lists show a clear peek of the next card or use consistent card widths and padding so names and images are fully visible.

issues.description: A large circular loading spinner is overlaid on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, making the featured card look unfinished or stuck loading.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the image has loaded, or use a skeleton/placeholder that does not cover the food photo.

issues.description: The last category chip ('Healthy') is clipped by the screen edge, so the filter row looks incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding or allow the chip row to scroll with a visible peek of the next item.

issues.description: The red notification badge sits outside the top-right of the bell button instead of being attached to the icon.
issues.suggestion: Reposition the badge so it overlaps the bell icon consistently (e.g. top-right of the icon itself).
